feynman-path-identity-96a5a696.title: Feynman Path Identity
feynman-path-identity-96a5a696.interpretation: Feynman Path Identity: The fundamental rule asserting that the transition amplitude is identically equal to the functional integral over all possible paths weighted by the action.

quantum-origin-923bff50.title: Quantum Origin
quantum-origin-923bff50.interpretation: Quantum Origin: A proposal where initial conditions emerge naturally from the geometry of the universe's wave function.
quantum-origin-923bff50.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

symmetry-tool-e08a1737.title: Symmetry Tool
symmetry-tool-e08a1737.interpretation: Symmetry Tool: The circular path used to easily calculate the total field without complex integration.
symmetry-tool-e08a1737.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

transverse-rule-e9560440.title: Transverse Rule
transverse-rule-e9560440.interpretation: Transverse Rule: Why magnetic fields point "around" wires rather than away from them.
transverse-rule-e9560440.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

symmetry-map-85aad343.title: Symmetry Map
symmetry-map-85aad343.interpretation: Symmetry Map: The use of radius, angle, and height to describe objects like wires and pipes.
symmetry-map-85aad343.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

dwarf-spheroids-65f28123.interpretation: Dwarf Spheroids: Why tiny, "dead" galaxies are the best places to hunt for dark matter light.
dwarf-spheroids-65f28123.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

energy-logic-23cb4051.title: Energy Logic
energy-logic-23cb4051.interpretation: Energy Logic: The proof that you don't spend power moving "sideways" because there is no force in that direction.
energy-logic-23cb4051.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

global-volume-3cffe761.title: Global Volume
global-volume-3cffe761.interpretation: Global Volume: How we add up the influence of every tiny "grain" of charge in a cloud.
global-volume-3cffe761.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

the-phase-clock-24c3658f.title: The Phase Clock
the-phase-clock-24c3658f.interpretation: The Phase Clock: The number that tells you if a wave is currently at its peak, trough, or zero.

galilean-transformation-f9f600b6.interpretation: Galilean Transformation: The classical mapping between coordinates in different inertial frames.
galilean-transformation-f9f600b6.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

sec-tensor-definition-bce8e1f3.title: SEC Tensor Definition
sec-tensor-definition-bce8e1f3.interpretation: Ricci Positivity: The requirement that the matter distribution forces the curvature to focus timelike world-lines.
sec-tensor-definition-bce8e1f3.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

homogeneous-density-relation-75ed62fc.title: Homogeneous Density Relation
homogeneous-density-relation-75ed62fc.interpretation: Uniform Distribution: The requirement that the gradient of the matter density vanishes across all spatial coordinates at a fixed cosmic time.
homogeneous-density-relation-75ed62fc.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

manifold-triple-identity-5f2c8b26.title: Manifold Triple Identity
manifold-triple-identity-5f2c8b26.interpretation: Manifold Triple Identity: The substantivalist rule defining the universe as an ordered triple where the manifold M is an independent constituent.
manifold-triple-identity-5f2c8b26.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

average-wavelength-shift-9fb69acb.title: Average Wavelength Shift
average-wavelength-shift-9fb69acb.interpretation: Average Wavelength Shift: The fundamental rule asserting that the average of forward and backward wavelengths is identically shifted from the rest value by time dilation.
average-wavelength-shift-9fb69acb.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

color-casimir-invariant-cf-362d2294.title: Color Casimir Invariant (C_F)
color-casimir-invariant-cf-362d2294.interpretation: Quantifies the effective 'strength' of the color charge for a quark in the fundamental representation of $SU(3)$.
color-casimir-invariant-cf-362d2294.symmetry_origin: The algebraic properties of the $SU(3)$ generators in the fundamental triplet state.
color-casimir-invariant-cf-362d2294.limits_and_boundary: Used to calculate the self-energy of quarks and the potential energy of color-bound states.

ckm-quark-mixing-rotation-bc49e921.title: Quark Flavor Rotation (CKM)
ckm-quark-mixing-rotation-bc49e921.interpretation: Describes the transformation from the mass eigenstates to the interaction (flavor) eigenstates for the down-type quark sector.
ckm-quark-mixing-rotation-bc49e921.symmetry_origin: The misalignment between the up-type and down-type Yukawa coupling matrices.
ckm-quark-mixing-rotation-bc49e921.limits_and_boundary: The unitary matrix $V_{ij}$ is the CKM matrix, governing all flavor-changing weak transitions.

su2-generators-pauli-algebra-ident-d1a57.title: SU(2) Algebra (Pauli Matrices)
su2-generators-pauli-algebra-ident-d1a57.interpretation: Defines the commutation relations for the generators of the SU(2) group, characterizing the non-abelian nature of spin and electroweak isospin.
su2-generators-pauli-algebra-ident-d1a57.symmetry_origin: The rotational invariance of a 2D complex Hilbert space and the structural constraints of the special unitary group.
su2-generators-pauli-algebra-ident-d1a57.limits_and_boundary: Identifies the fundamental SU(2) doublets (e.g., electrons and neutrinos) as the primary building blocks of the electroweak sector.
